headline: Troyes arrive in Toulouse on five straight defeats
summary: Toulouse host Troyes in Ligue 1, with the game moved to Sunday after the Haute-Garonne prefecture flagged demonstrations planned in the city on Saturday. Troyes arrive on 5 straight defeats, having conceded 15 goals in that run, and sit 17th with 4 points. Toulouse won 3-0 at Le Mans last week. That is why the market makes Toulouse 58.3% favourites against 18.9% for Troyes, rating them about 0.86 goals the better side, with 2.89 goals expected.
read: Toulouse are unbeaten in four and creating over two expected goals a game, and the market makes them 58.3% favourites to beat a Troyes side that has lost five in a row and conceded 15 goals doing it. The fixture was pushed from Saturday to Sunday at the request of the prefecture because of demonstrations in Toulouse, but nothing about the match itself changes: the market sees a home win by roughly a goal, on a goals line set as high as 3.0.

facts.fact: The LFP confirmed Toulouse v Troyes was moved from Saturday 24 October to Sunday 25 October at the request of the Haute-Garonne prefecture, because of national demonstrations planned in Toulouse on the Saturday.
facts.meaning: The game now kicks off Sunday at 17:15, giving both squads an extra day before a match that is now the back end of the weekend.

facts.fact: Troyes have lost all five of their last five Ligue 1 matches, scoring 3 goals and conceding 15.
facts.meaning: They arrive in Toulouse on the worst run of any side in this fixture and without a win to build on.

facts.fact: Toulouse are unbeaten in four: a 3-0 win at Le Mans, 2-2 at Monaco, 3-2 at home to Le Havre and 2-2 at Lorient.
facts.meaning: Only the oldest of those five games, a 0-1 home loss to Lille on 3 September, is a defeat.

facts.fact: Toulouse are 58.3% to win, against 18.9% for Troyes and 22.8% for the draw.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that the home side takes the three points, and more than three times Troyes' chance.

facts.fact: The market rates Toulouse about 0.86 goals the better side, with the main handicap line at -0.75.
facts.meaning: Toulouse are expected to win by roughly a goal; a one-goal win only half covers the -0.75 line.

facts.fact: The goals line sits at 3.0, with Over priced at 47.2% — the market's 50/50 total is 2.89 goals.
facts.meaning: A high line: the market leans just under three goals and slightly favours the Under at this number.

facts.fact: Toulouse average 2.06 xG created per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are generating enough chances to support the favourite's price rather than just home advantage.

facts.fact: Troyes are 17th of 18 in Ligue 1 with 4 points from 7 games and a goal difference of -11.
facts.meaning: Only one side in the division sits below them after seven rounds.

sources.fact: The LFP confirmed the Toulouse v Troyes Ligue 1 match was postponed from Saturday 24 October to Sunday 25 October at the request of the Haute-Garonne prefecture.
The postponement was requested because of a new national mobilisation and demonstrations planned for Saturday in Toulouse.
The match is a Ligue 1 fixture counting for the 8th matchday, originally scheduled for Saturday at 17:15.
The rescheduled match is set for Sunday 25 October at 17:15, in agreement with the broadcaster Ligue1+.
The fixture is due to be played at the Stadium de Toulouse.
